snippet.title: Trust the System - Demo trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://shorturl.at/4LxFD
Play in your browser: https://soliles.itch.io/trust-the-system?ac=youtube
Play on IOS: https://shorturl.at/WCU1k
Play on Android: https://shorturl.at/x2Y1A

Hi!
Here's the trailer of my new game, Trust the System! 

Trust the System is an intriguing incremental game where you mindlessly stamp papers to explore the System's restricted corridors. Upgrade your tools to better uncover what your job is really about...

Give it a try, I hope you will enjoy it. 
If so, don't forget to leave a review! It helps out so much.

See you!

Trailer music: "80s Zombies Movie" by Clement Panchout
